The massive script covers a large portion of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s upper hemisphere, and appears to be a short story chronicling the difficult life of an alien mercenary.

summary.text:
# 地表文字 / Surface Writing

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration

## 如何开始 How it starts

没有战略资源的不宜居普通星球可能生成（2级，权重3）。

Can spawn on a regular uninhabitable planet without a strategic resource (level 2, weight 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 anomaly.635“外星手迹”：d_society_3 矿藏 + alien_writing 修正，记录标本 mercenary_story；30天后触发 story.5（共享报告）。

Single result anomaly.635 "Alien Writing": d_society_3 deposit plus alien_writing modifier and specimen mercenary_story; story.5 (shared report) fires after 30 days.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果。

Single outcome.

No empire differences.
